data.content_ref: inline:The ritual is correctly flagging a genuine double-standard: the nu-verdict artifacts (SRC_006, SRC_008) and the critic-failure artifacts (SRC_007, SRC_009) simultaneously assert that verdicts on SRC_005 are sound AND that the critics producing those verdicts failed — revealing that the adjudication system accepts verdicts as 'sound and relevant' even when their generating critics are known to have failed, which is an internal contradiction in the ritual's adjudication logic.
